note: Yards under the deck, draft 5 (27 October 2026): three yards nested side by side south of Hopple (receiving, hump bowl, departure), staging north of Hopple, flat yard to the river, own freight ramp to the CS bridge. Track spacing 4.5 m (the real yard), No. 8 turnouts in the yard and No. 10 at the bridge, compound ladders (14.3/7.15 deg), curves R 200 m and above in the yards, 300 m on leads, 450 m on the ramp. Footprint measured like today’s yard (tracks + 3 m, gaps under 24 m closed).
